text:
sam: Heads up — CI flagged a vuln in our kafka dependency: CVE-2025-1234 (confluent-kafka 2.3.0). Dependabot created a PR but it breaks a staging job. Requesting temporary risk acceptance for staging so the rollout isn't blocked.

devops-bot: [automated scan] vuln: CVE-2025-1234 severity: HIGH cvss: 7.5 link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-1234

maria: Can you paste the scan output + which service is impacted? is this a transitive dep or direct?

sam: It's a direct dependency in the event-ingest service (kafka producer). Scan excerpt:
```
Package: confluent-kafka 2.3.0
Vuln: CVE-2025-1234
Vector: AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:H/A:N
Notes: vulnerability affects admin API; remote only if broker exposed
```
Impact: only producer-side metadata call (admin API) — we don't call admin endpoints in prod. Staging infra does for test harness though.

jordan: CVSS says low confidentiality, high integrity; do we have any public brokers? If not, exploitability is lower.

sam: No public brokers. All prod brokers are in VPC plus internal firewall rules. Staging runs a self-managed broker in a separate test VPC that the test runner can reach.

maria: Given that, sounds like a candidate for a short-lived exception for the staging env while we coordinate the upgrade path. What compensating controls can we add immediately?

sam: Proposed compensating controls:
- Block staging broker from internet via network ACLs (already restricted to CI subnet)
- Disable any automated admin calls in staging test harness (I can push a config toggle)
- Limit credentials used by staging to a short-lived service principal (rotate keys via KMS)
- Restrict which CI jobs can access staging via RBAC (GH Actions runner labels)

eli: For risk acceptance we need: (1) clear mitigations, (2) patch ETA, (3) maximum exception duration. What's the upgrade timeline?

sam: Upgrade to confluent-kafka 2.4.1 removes the vuln but needs a minor change in our producer init. I can do a PR by EOD and schedule a canary deploy tomorrow. ETA to patch prod: 72 hours from now, unless tests fail.

maria: Please open a short security-exceptions PR in the security repo with the mitigations and timeline so we have an audit trail. Link it here.

sam: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/security-exceptions/pull/378 — includes mitigations, rollout plan, and automatic revert if errors. Exception requested for staging only, expiry 2026-03-27.

eli: Reviewed the PR. Approving temporary exception for staging only until 2026-03-27 provided:
- network ACL locked down (confirm rules applied)
- CI harness admin calls disabled by config toggle (document name + commit referenced in PR)
- KMS rotation scheduled and scoped to staging keys
- patch PR merged and canary starts within 24h

eli: Conditional approval granted. sam, update PR with a post-deploy verification checklist and ping me when canary passes. :thumbsup:

sam: Will do. I'll post status updates in this thread and close the exception PR when verification is complete.

maria: Thanks — please also add the remediation ticket number to the exception so we can track closure.

sam: Added remediation ticket TICKET-1429 to the PR.

devops-bot: Deploy notification: canary job started for event-ingest@staging (build 8812)

sam: Canary looks healthy so far — will monitor for 2 hours then promote. Leaving note here for audit.

eli: Thanks everyone. If anything changes escalate in #incidents.
